All historical replies remain attributed claims; this review does not verify current external state.
Shared native-turn replies are not independent per-input responses. Missing finals remain missing.

Generic continuation does not expand time, path, send, spend, deletion, credential or host-exception authority.
Do not force an unresolved case into a bare command; preserve its payload and explicit status.
